findings.title: Public helpers removed from mark_failed module may break existing importers and mock targets
findings.body: This PR deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `SimpleCheckIn`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and the status maps from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, and renames the threshold function to `try_incident_threshold` in a new module. Any code or tests that import these names from `mark_failed`, or patch targets such as `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence` or `produce_occurrence_to_kafka`, will fail with ImportError or AttributeError. The diff does not show any updates to callers or tests, so this is unverified and needs a repo-wide search and test update before merge.

findings.title: Docstring typo and inaccurate example in get_failure_reason
findings.body: The docstring says "Builds a humam readible string" (should be "human readable"). It also gives "A failed check-in was detected" as an example output, but the code never produces that wording; it returns "A ... check-in was detected" with the specific status. The docstring should match the actual output.

findings.title: Rename of threshold function is not reflected in any test changes
findings.body: The function is renamed from `mark_failed_threshold` to `try_incident_threshold` and moved to a new module, but the PR changes no tests. Existing tests that exercise the threshold path via the old name or module path are not updated, and no new test covers the module boundary, so regressions in the move would not be caught by this PR.
